# ANNI festival artwork

Seven original illustrations generated for the ANNI COFFEE demo, then encoded as 768×1152 WebP assets. No text, wheel labels, reward values or business logic are baked into these images. Decorative only (`alt=""`, pointer events disabled).

The theme catalog selects the matching scene. Keep filenames aligned with `dist/js/themes.js`. The standalone HTML packaging script embeds these files; no third-party image host is needed.

- halloween: pumpkins, moon, cafe street
- christmas: evergreen, snow, gifts
- new-year: navy, gold fireworks
- lunar-new-year: Vietnamese flowers, red envelopes, traditional cakes
- reunification: Vietnamese flags, lotus, peaceful city
- womens-day: rose garden, satin, flowers
- teachers-day: books, fountain pen, flowers, warm study
